name: Sail Rec!
description_short: A non-profit learn-to-sail program run by Greater Fall River RE-CREATION at its boathouse in Heritage State Park, where new sailors learn to captain their own boat on the river. Spring and summer programs are offered.
swim_waterfront_notes: Sailing takes place on the river from RE-CREATION's Boathouse at Heritage State Park, under a permit arrangement with the MA Department of Conservation and Recreation (DCR).
